result.summary: The street features a paved sidewalk on the left side adjacent to commercial and residential buildings, while the right side consists of a large grassy area with mature trees but no visible paved walkway. There are no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures visible, and on-street parallel parking may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, potentially forcing pedestrians to walk on uneven grass or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points visible, which may lead to unpredictable mid-block crossings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side can block the view of pedestrians, especially children, from oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks with curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or speed cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street bordered by a large green space with mature trees. There is a complete absence of paved sidewalks or marked pedestrian crossings in the immediate vicinity, requiring pedestrians to use the unpaved grass or the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians on the near side of the street, forcing them onto the grass or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the green space

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees and parked cars may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line and within the green space

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk along the edge of the green space to provide a dedicated pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to provide designated crossing points across the residential street.

result.summary: The street environment features a wide, unmarked roadway with a sidewalk present only on one side. The lack of marked crossings and pedestrian signals, combined with the significant crossing distance, creates a moderately high-risk environment for pedestrians despite the presence of mature street trees and a bus shelter.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the paved area without clear lane markings or pedestrian refuge encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases exposure time for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk on the grass or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross this wide street safely, particularly near the bus stop.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to designate safe crossing points, especially near the bus stop.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend the paved sidewalk network to the left side of the street to provide a continuous, accessible path for all users.

result.summary: This residential street features a continuous concrete sidewalk, though its effective width is compromised by a large mature tree and utility pole. The pavement is in fair condition with visible cracking and vegetation growth, and there is no dedicated buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree trunk and utility pole significantly narrow the clear walking path, creating a pinch point for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left of the image on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Tripping Hazard
hazards.description: Uneven sidewalk slabs and weeds growing through cracks create a risk of trips and falls.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Leveling uneven slabs and removing vegetation to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated lighting for the sidewalk to improve visibility and personal security during nighttime hours.
